summary: Sick backpacker unable to continue on the West Maroon Trail at ~11,200 ft, about five miles from Maroon Lake; MRA fielded a 7-member team and CareFlight landed at the scene, transporting the patient to Aspen Valley Health.
location: West Maroon Trail, ~11,200 ft, ~5 miles from Maroon Lake
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; CareFlight of the Rockies; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
